name: Power Red Degreaser

features.text: Loosens and emulsifies grease and grime
Rich foam lifts soil and rinses away oils.
Can be used as is or diluted.

description: A citrus-scented, all-purpose heavy-duty cleaning and degreasing compound.
application: Light-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:20 with water. Medium-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:10 with water. Heavy-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:5 with water. 1) Dilute with water and apply with spray bottle or sponge. 2) Spray or wipe diluted solution on surface to be cleaned. 3) If needed, scrub surface with a brush or mop. 4) Rinse surface with clean water. AVOID CONTACT WITH ALUMINUM, MAGNESIUM, AND PAINTED SURFACES, AS SPOTTING OR DAMAGE MAY OCCUR.
